izwapurtin.g: mfn. one who has stored up sacrificial rites, or one who has performed sacrifices for himself and good works for others.

izwarasmi.g: mfn. one who wishes for reins or bridles, RV. i, 122, 13.

izwarga.g: m., the Adhvaryu priest, TS. & TBr.

izwartodyukta.g: mfn. zealous or active for a desired object.

izwasampadin.g: mfn. effecting anything desired or wished for, Kathās.

izwasva.g: mfn. one who wishes for horses, RV. i, 122, 13.

izwasvizwakft.g: mfn. one to whom a Sviṣṭakṛt sacrifice has been offered, ŚBr.

izwata.g: desirableness, the state of being beloved or reverenced.

izwatama.g: mfn. most desired, best beloved, beloved, dearest.

izwatara.g: mfn. more desired, more dear, dearer.

izwatas.g: ind. according to one's wish or desire.

izwatititva.g: n. delight in hospitality, Bcar. vii, 45.

izwavat.g: mfn. possessing a desired object, AV. xviii, 3, 20.

izwavrata.g: mfn. that by which good works succeed, RV. iii, 59, 9.; TS.

izwayajus.g: mfn. one who has spoken the sacrificial verses, VS.; TS.

izwayaman.g: mfn. going according to desire, RV. ix, 88, 3.

izwi.g: is, f. seeking, going after, RV.

izwihotra.g: n. the office of an Hotṛ at an Iṣṭi sacrifice Comm. on TBr. iii, 5, 1.

izwikfta.g: n. a particular sacrifice or festive rite, MBh.

izwimaya.g: mf n. consisting of sacrifices, VP.

izwin.g: mfn. one who has sacrificed, TS.; Kāṭh.

izwirupa.g: n. the property of the Iṣṭi, ŚBr.

izwisradda.g: n. a particular funeral rite, VP.

izwitva.g: n. the being an Iṣṭi sacrifice, AitBr.; Jaim.

izwiyajuka.g: mfn. one who offers an Iṣṭi sacrifice, ŚBr.

izwva.g: ind.p. having sacrificed or worshipped, AV.

izwyayana.g: n. a sacrifice lasting a long time, ĀśvŚr.
